query: Consider WECC's Non-Disclosure Agreement; Does the document mention that some obligations of the Agreement may survive the termination of the Agreement?
gold: b. Upon any termination of this Agreement, Data Recipient shall return to WECC all Non-Public Information in Data Recipient’s possession or destroy all Non-Public Information in Data Recipient’s possession and certify to WECC in writing that all Non-Public Information has been returned or destroyed, except as may be otherwise required by law in which case the confidentiality obligations of this Agreement shall survive termination.
rag_answer: Yes. The document mentions that some obligations may survive termination. Specifically, Section 7(b) states that upon termination, the Data Recipient must return or destroy all Non-Public Information, “except as may be otherwise required by law in which case the confidentiality obligations of this Agreement shall survive termination.”

judge.gold_summary: 协议终止后，Data Recipient需返回或销毁非公开信息；如法律另有要求，保密义务在协议终止后继续存续。
judge.answer_summary: 系统回答确认文档提到部分义务可存续，并引用Section 7(b)说明终止时返回/销毁非公开信息，且法律另有要求时保密义务在终止后存续。
judge.reason: 系统回答覆盖了金标的关键结论：终止后的返回/销毁义务以及保密义务在特定情况下存续，虽补充了条款编号但未与金标矛盾。
